district: Mt. Shasta Union Elementary School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the District to issue $9.1 million in bonds, with independent oversight and audits, to repair or replace roofs, plumbing, electrical, and heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems and to upgrade emergency communication systems and fire alarms, repaid by a property tax levied while the bonds are outstanding.

tax.text: A yes vote approves the issuance of $59 million in bonds funded by a property tax levy to finance school safety and security upgrades.
tax.quote: authorizing $59,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $28 per $100,000 of assessed value ($4,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A yes vote provides bond funding to repair and upgrade safety features at district public elementary and middle schools.
schools.quote: To provide safe elementary/ middle schools by upgrading to current earthquake/ building safety codes; improving school security, classroom locks, fencing, lighting, emergency communications, and cameras

tax.text: A no vote opposes the issuance of $59 million in bonds and the associated property tax levy.
tax.quote: authorizing $59,000,000 in bonds at legal rates, levying $28 per $100,000 of assessed value ($4,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A no vote denies bond funding for facility and security improvements at district public schools.
schools.quote: To provide safe elementary/ middle schools by upgrading to current earthquake/ building safety codes; improving school security, classroom locks, fencing, lighting, emergency communications, and cameras
